definitions.gloss: the skill or ability to negotiate effectively; the leverage one holds in a negotiation
definitions.explanation: The ability to achieve favorable outcomes in negotiations, whether between countries, companies, or individuals. Covers both personal skill (persuasion, tactics, communication) and structural leverage (market position, alternatives, information). Common in business, diplomacy, and career writing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧ (negotiation) + {力|りょく} (power, ability), patterned on other {力|りょく}-compounds like ⟦{行動力|こうどうりょく}→行動力：08522_koudouryoku⟧ (initiative) and ⟦{判断力|はんだんりょく}→判断力：17617_handanryoku⟧ (decisiveness). The suffix {力|りょく} is extremely productive in Japanese business and self-development vocabulary.

TWO SENSES OF "POWER":
{交渉力|こうしょうりょく} covers both of the English concepts "negotiating skill" and "bargaining power":
- PERSONAL SKILL: the ability of an individual to argue, persuade, and reach favorable terms.
- STRUCTURAL LEVERAGE: the objective advantage one party holds — e.g., a supplier with few competitors has strong {交渉力|こうしょうりょく} over buyers.

The context usually makes clear which is meant; ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交渉力|こうしょうりょく} (personal negotiating skill) emphasizes the first, while ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交渉力|こうしょうりょく} (market bargaining power) emphasizes the second.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have negotiating skill / bargaining power
- {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to be strong in negotiation
- {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: to be weak at negotiation
- {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire negotiating skills
- {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train one's negotiating skills
- {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate one's negotiating skill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{説得力|せっとくりょく}→説得力：08525_settokuryoku⟧: persuasiveness; the ability to convince — focuses on verbal / logical persuasion of a single listener.
- {営業力|えいぎょうりょく}: sales ability — the skill of closing sales, a narrower business-oriented concept.
- {交渉術|こうしょうじゅつ}: negotiating technique; the art of negotiation — emphasizes specific techniques and methods rather than raw ability.
- {発言力|はつげんりょく}: clout; influence in discussion — the weight one's opinion carries in a group.

USAGE:
- Business: supplier-buyer relationships, labor-management negotiations, salary negotiation
- Politics and diplomacy: international treaties, trade agreements
- Self-help and career writing: "skills to develop," {交渉力|こうしょうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧ is a common heading
